metadata.title: Russia → U.S. media/political influence — evidence graph
metadata.status: 1.0 + batch 05 (GRU information-distribution architecture: Guccifer 2.0 → The Smoking Gun / The Hill / a congressional candidate directly; Stone→Breitbart, Stone→Corsi→WND, Stone→Bannon→campaign). Recipients typed downstream/unwitting. New do_not_claim: Stone knew Guccifer was GRU.
rules: A connection is not a conclusion. Never merge an outlet/producer (may be state-connected) with a downstream personality (may be an unwitting amplifier).
No edge without a citation, except do_not_claim edges which record an absence.
do_not_claim edges are first-class negative findings; render them, never drop or silently upgrade them.
The finding is convergent INDEPENDENT paths terminating in the same Russian state/Kremlin-linked network — not any single chain.
metadata.normalized: 2026-09-10 — schema frozen at 1.0; fields uniform across all edges/nodes.

nodes.label: Prevezon Holdings
nodes.notes: Katsyv's company; centre of the Magnitsky-sanctions litigation; hired BakerHostetler.

nodes.label: Denis Katsyv
nodes.notes: Owner of Prevezon; Russian-linked businessman at the centre of the Magnitsky/Prevezon litigation.

nodes.label: BakerHostetler
nodes.notes: US law firm hired by Prevezon; in turn hired Fusion GPS. NOT a Russian entity — a contracted intermediary.

nodes.label: Fusion GPS
nodes.notes: US opposition-research firm. Worked the Prevezon matter via BakerHostetler and interacted with Veselnitskaya. NOT established as part of a Russian operation — this edge is typed separately. No conspiracy spaghetti.

nodes.label: Glenn Simpson
nodes.notes: Fusion GPS co-founder. Testified he did NOT know of the Trump Tower meeting beforehand.

nodes.label: Human Rights Accountability Global Initiative Foundation (HRAGI)
nodes.notes: Nominal Russian-American adoption org; practical activity = anti-Magnitsky lobbying; ≥$300k from Russian interests (Akhmetshin testimony).

nodes.label: Rep. Dana Rohrabacher
nodes.notes: Russia-friendly member of Congress; anti-Magnitsky lobbying target. INFLUENCE RECIPIENT, not a controlled asset.

nodes.label: Anti-Magnitsky documentary

nodes.label: Rhona Graff
nodes.notes: Trump Organization; contacted in the VK overture.

nodes.label: The Smoking Gun
nodes.notes: Received GRU-provided stolen material via Guccifer 2.0. DOJ: American recipients were not alleged to know they were communicating with Russian intelligence — recipient, not collaborator.

nodes.label: The Hill
nodes.notes: Received GRU-provided material via Guccifer 2.0. DOJ: American recipients were not alleged to know they were communicating with Russian intelligence — recipient, not collaborator.

nodes.label: U.S. congressional candidate (2016)
nodes.notes: Received stolen material on opponent via Guccifer 2.0. DOJ: American recipients were not alleged to know they were communicating with Russian intelligence — recipient, not collaborator.

nodes.label: Breitbart
nodes.notes: Published Stone's Aug 5 2016 article crediting Guccifer 2.0 (not Russia) for the DNC hack.

nodes.label: Jerome Corsi
nodes.notes: WND (2016); Stone's operative — media production + political op + WikiLeaks dissemination. Bridge node.

nodes.label: Steve Bannon
nodes.notes: Told by Stone of an Assange relationship / inside WikiLeaks info; later campaign chairman. Received info; NOT coordinating with Russia.

edges.claim: On August 5, 2016 Stone published a Breitbart article arguing Guccifer 2.0 — not Russia — was responsible for the DNC hack, relying on the Guccifer persona's statements. Guccifer then contacted Stone; they exchanged DMs Aug 14–Sept.
Reached an American audience.

Stone worked with Jerome Corsi (WND); on July 25, 2016 Stone emailed Corsi instructing him to contact Assange and obtain pending WikiLeaks material. Corsi shifted from producing WND content with Stone to acting as an operative assisting Stone.
Corsi worked for WorldNetDaily (WND) in 2016.
At Stone's direction, Corsi sought to contact Assange / obtain pending WikiLeaks material.
Reached a U.S. audience.

Stone told Bannon (before Bannon joined the campaign) that he had a relationship with Assange and inside information about WikiLeaks; after Bannon became chairman, Stone continued telling him WikiLeaks would release damaging Clinton material.
Bannon became Trump campaign chairman; the campaign developed a communications strategy around potential WikiLeaks releases (Gates to Mueller).

NOT ESTABLISHED: that Stone knew Guccifer 2.0 was Russian intelligence (the GRU). The evidence establishes Stone's communications with Guccifer 2.0 and WikiLeaks and his publishing about the persona; knowledge of the Russian-intelligence identity is not established. ASSUMING_TRUE would raise Stone's consequence, not the knowledge claim.
